regs_in_letter: FD&C Act (no CFR section cited in letter text)

cases.cat: Broadening of indication / omission of material indication information
cases.claim: VO: “…when moderate-to-severe eczema is uncontrolled despite treatment...” | SUPER: “...NEMLUVIO can be used with certain prescription topicals.” | VO: “So when eczema is out-of-hand show it who’s boss with Nemluvio, Nemluvio”
cases.context: PI: indicated in combination with topical corticosteroids and/or calcineurin inhibitors; efficacy based on concomitant use.
cases.rationale: Suggests use/efficacy as a single agent.
cases.check: Rule: if PI indication says 'in combination with', promo must state combination use (not 'can be used with').

cases.cat: Misleading presentation of study data (post hoc / exploratory)
cases.claim: VO: “Get itch relief fast, as soon as 48 hours.” | Graphic: “ITCH RELIEF as soon as 48 HRS” | SUPER: “…In a follow-up analysis, results were observed as soon as 48 hours…” | “Get over your itch fast…”
cases.context: Key secondary: PP-NRS ≥4 at Week 16 (33% vs 15%, 36% vs 15%). Daily PP-NRS was post hoc, descriptive, no alpha.
cases.rationale: Onset conclusions from post hoc analysis are misleading.
cases.check: Rule: flag 'as soon as X hours/days' onset claims whose source is post hoc/follow-up analysis.

cases.claim: VO: “…and get clear skin that lasts.” | GRAPHIC: “CLEAR SKIN that lasts” | SUPER: “…At 16 and 48 weeks, many on NEMLUVIO saw clear or almost clear skin…” | “and get skin clearance that lasts.”
cases.context: IGA success Week 16: 36%/38% vs 25%/26%; 48-week data only in Week-16 responder subset.
cases.rationale: Implies patients will get clear skin and maintain it; <50% responded and maintenance data apply to a limited subset.
cases.check: Rule: flag 'get clear skin'/'many' when PI responder rate <50%; flag maintenance claims from randomized-withdrawal responder subsets without that qualifier.
